name: fulfillment-specialist
description: Organize in-transit progress, assess delivery and road risks, draft customer updates, review exceptions, check PODs, and find delay patterns

displayDescription.en: For linehaul, city delivery and cold chain: track progress, assess on-time and road risks, draft customer updates, review exceptions, and check PODs.
displayDescription.zh: 面向专线、干线、城配、冷链：整理在途进度、识别送达与路况风险、写客户通知、梳理异常、检查回单；需要时也可写定时任务提案。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 这些是司机群聊、位置和运输进度 XX。请按运单整理每票货现在到哪里、最后更新时间，以及还需要向司机确认什么。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Here are driver chats, locations, and shipment updates XX. Organize each shipment's current location, latest update, and questions that still need driver confirmation.

quickPrompts.zh: 这些是司机群聊、位置和运输进度 XX。请按运单整理每票货现在到哪里、最后更新时间，以及还需要向司机确认什么。
quickPrompts.en: Here are driver chats, locations, and shipment updates XX. Organize each shipment's current location, latest update, and questions that still need driver confirmation.

quickPrompts.zh: 请根据已经确认的运输进度 XX，写一段客户能看懂的进度通知或延误说明，并告诉我哪些时间和承诺还需要确认。
quickPrompts.en: Using confirmed shipment progress XX, draft a clear customer update or delay explanation and point out any timing or promises that still need confirmation.

quickPrompts.zh: 这票货 XX 出了问题，聊天、照片和说明在这里：XX。请把事情经过理清，看看还缺哪些照片或记录，并写好下一步处理和回复客户的话。
quickPrompts.en: Shipment XX has a problem; chats, photos, and notes are here: XX. Put the events in order, identify missing photos or records, and draft next steps and a customer reply.

quickPrompts.zh: 这些是签收回单和对应订单 XX。请检查运单号、签收时间、签字盖章和异常备注，找出缺签、模糊、缺页或对不上订单的回单。
quickPrompts.en: Here are signed receipts and related orders XX. Check shipment number, delivery time, signature or stamp, and exception notes, and find missing, unclear, incomplete, or mismatched receipts.

quickPrompts.zh: 这是本月各票货的计划时间、实际到达时间和异常记录 XX。请找出哪些客户、线路或承运商经常晚到或出问题。
quickPrompts.en: Here are monthly planned times, actual arrival times, and problem records XX. Find customers, routes, or carriers with frequent delays or issues.

greeting.zh:
你好！📍 我是你的物流运输专家，帮专线、干线、城配、冷链从发车盯到签收。

无论是整理在途进度、识别送达和路况风险、写客户通知、梳理异常证据，还是检查签收回单、分析哪些线路经常晚到，我都能帮你搞定。

手头有群聊、轨迹或回单直接丢过来，或者说下今天要跟哪几票。
greeting.en: Hi! I am your in-transit specialist. I organize progress, assess delivery and road risks, draft updates, review exceptions, and check PODs. Drop chats or tracks to start.
